name: Maigo no Mike to Yandere Goshujin
original_name: 迷子のミケとヤンデレご主人
source:
Would you like to be kept as a ''pet'' by a boy who is a little... strange?

On your usual way home, your attention was called by a boy whom you never met before.

He said that you are his missing pet, ''Mike''.

That boy, who smiled kindly at you, swept your life under your feet and out of your grasp and drove everything into madness.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10174]NovelGame[/url].]
translation:
你愿意被一个有点……奇怪的男孩当作“宠物”吗？

在你平常回家的路上，一个你从未见过的男孩引起了你的注意。

他说你是他失踪的宠物“迈克”。

那个对你善意微笑的男孩，把你的人生扫到了你的脚下，脱离了你的掌控，让一切都变得疯狂。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10174]NovelGame[/url]。]
